name: aws-cloudtrail
description: Reads AWS CloudTrail configuration and event metadata, runs bounded CloudTrail query/lookups, and executes typed approval-gated CloudTrail administration actions through fixed AWS JSON-RPC operations.

risk.read: bounded AWS CloudTrail JSON-RPC reads using fixed action names and SigV4 authentication
risk.write: typed CloudTrail trail, channel, dashboard, event-data-store, import, logging, federation, selector, tagging, and resource-policy actions only
risk.approval: reverse ETL writes require plan, preview, explicit approval, and destructive confirmation where declared
